title: Introduction
lede: Signal is the design system behind every Intelligence Node product, deck and page.

title: Install and use
lede: One stylesheet brings in every token. Components and icons come from the same folder.

title: Color
lede: Eight colors in three tiers. Every other tint in the interface is one of them at lower opacity.

title: Typography
lede: One typeface. Hierarchy comes from weight and size alone.

title: Layout and spacing
lede: An 8px rhythm, a 32px grid and a short list of radii. Paper underneath, Surface on top.

title: Gradients
lede: Six coded gradients, one per area of intelligence. Smooth blooms with grain, anchored in the grid.

title: Iconography
lede: A 151-icon duotone line set. Ink carries the structure, coral marks the subject.

title: Motion and interaction
lede: Slow, sparse and purposeful. Light travels along the grid.

title: Logo and imagery
lede: A dot-density sphere and a wordmark, and photography of real people making decisions.

title: Voice and content
lede: Confident and precise, never hype. The authority of the data, not the tone of a vendor.

title: Components
lede: Seventeen React primitives, styled entirely from tokens, with typed props and usage notes.

title: Brand components
lede: The logo, the line grid and gradient tiles.

title: Icon
lede: The 151-icon duotone set as a component.

title: Kits and templates
lede: Start from something built: a marketing-site kit and two slide templates.
